text:
incident-bot: PAGER: High error rate on api-gateway (us-west-2). 502/504 spike observed across edge proxies. Trigger: 5m error rate > 30%. Severity: P1. Paging on-call. https://dashboards.redwood.internal/alerts/1723456789 :rotating_light:

alex (sre-oncall): On-call here, acknowledging. Pulling up gateway metrics and envoy logs. Will update in 2m. :eyes:

maya (platform): seeing same. 502s correlate with upstream timeout to gateway-backend pool-gw-a. 5xx rate jumped ~12:34 UTC.

ingrid (deploy): FYI I rolled out gateway-service v2.4.9 to us-west-2 at 12:28 UTC (canary -> 50%). No errors in canary during rollout but ramped to 50% at ~12:33.

alex (sre-oncall): ok tagging that. Quick checks:
- `kubectl -n infra get pods -l app=gateway-service -o wide` shows 6/12 pods Ready in us-west-2
- envoy upstream metrics show a lot of `upstream_rq_timeouts` for cluster `gateway-backend`

ops-bot: deploy-bot: deployment gateway-service v2.4.9 completed rollout stage: 50% -> 100% at 12:36 UTC (link: https://k8s.redwood.internal/deploy/8237)

sam (product-ops): any customer-facing impact? Are external API requests failing or timing out?

maya (platform): yes some 502s visible at the edge, ~18% of requests from mobile clients returned 502 over last 10m. Error budget at risk.

alex (sre-oncall): reproducing locally with a curl against the gateway edge LB shows intermittent 502s and `upstream read timeout`. Example response header: `x-envoy-upstream-service-time: 1500` and `x-envoy-decorator-operation: gateway.internal`.

alex (sre-oncall): digging into logs, snippet below (filtered):
```
2024-06-18T12:35:43Z gateway-service gw-5 pod/gw-5 error: upstream timeout to 10.2.4.11:8080 status=504
2024-06-18T12:35:44Z gateway-service gw-2 pod/gw-2 error: connection reset by peer to backend 10.2.4.12:8080
2024-06-18T12:35:46Z gateway-service gw-9 pod/gw-9 warn: high queue length on worker-thread
```

maya (platform): preliminary hypothesis: new v2.4.9 has a regression in connection pooling causing backlog + upstream timeouts under p50-p90 load. Need to confirm.

ingrid (deploy): I can rollback the rollout to v2.4.8 now if that helps.

alex (sre-oncall): Do it. Roll back canary -> full rollback. But before full rollback, let's disable the autoscaler for gateway service to stop creating more pods that might be unhealthy.

ingrid (deploy): initiating rollback to v2.4.8. Command: `kubectl -n infra set image deploy/gateway-service gateway=registry.redwood/gateway:2.4.8 --record`

ops-bot: Triggered rollback job #8241. Notifying CI/CD.

maya (platform): Also flipping connection timeout to 10s for upstream as short-term mitigation (increasing upstream timeout actually; experimenting). Pushing a config change to envoy with traffic split to older cluster.

alex (sre-oncall): Redirecting traffic: adding fallback routing to region eu-west-1 for non-auth critical paths to reduce load on us-west-2. Command run: `routingctl set-fallback --from us-west-2 --to eu-west-1 --paths /v1/generate,/v1/embeddings`

sam (product-ops): Sending a short heads-up to customers: "We’re investigating elevated 502/504 errors in us-west-2. Some API requests may return 502. Engineers are rolling back a recent gateway deploy and applying mitigations. We'll post updates every 15m." Posting now. :loudspeaker:

alex (sre-oncall): Rollback progressing. Monitoring metrics and logs. Current actions list: [rollback in progress, envoy timeout tweak, traffic fallback, disable autoscaler].

maya (platform): After the rollback started, error rate dropped from 35% -> 12% within 90s. p95 latency also improving. Continuing to watch.

ingrid (deploy): Rollback to v2.4.8 completed at 12:44 UTC. Rolling back autoscaler change.

ops-bot: deploy-bot: rollback job #8241 succeeded. (link: https://k8s.redwood.internal/deploy/8241) :white_check_mark:

alex (sre-oncall): Passing to post-incident triage. I will stay on to collect traces for 30m then hand off to shift. If anything spikes again, re-pager.

sam (product-ops): Customer comms updated: "Deploy rollback completed and error rates are improving. We will follow up with a detailed incident report." 

maya (platform): quick note for follow-up: capture heap/conn-pool stats for v2.4.9 instances and compare to v2.4.8. Suspect connection leaks.

alex (sre-oncall): Assigning follow-up: ingrid (deploy) to own rollback/root cause and maya (platform) to own diagnostic traces. Tagging for postmortem.

ingrid (deploy): acknowledged. I'll pull the release CI logs and runtime metrics, and pin the rollback PR.

alex (sre-oncall): Handoff to on-call backup @maya in 30m. I'll mark this thread as incident-contained once error rate < 1% for 15m.

incident-bot: Incident update: status=contained, containment_time=2024-06-18T12:47:10Z, incident_channel=#incidents/1723456789

sam (product-ops): Thanks all. Follow-up: schedule postmortem meeting tomorrow 10:00 UTC. I'll create the ticket and add stakeholders. :calendar:
